bespoke_clusters.rule_of_thumb_mnemonic: USA Archery range signals mandate 2 whistle blasts to walk to the shooting line and 1 blast to nock and shoot.
core_mechanism_bullets: USA Archery range signals mandate 2 whistle blasts to walk to the shooting line and 1 blast to nock and shoot.
Three whistle blasts signal walk to the targets to score, and 5 or more blasts mandate an immediate emergency cease-fire.
bespoke_clusters.worked_field_example: If a deer walks into the safety buffer behind the 18-meter target butts, the Range Officer blows 5 whistle blasts and every archer un-nocks immediately.
bespoke_clusters.counselor_tabletop_demo: Drill the 4 official USA Archery whistle commands at the tabletop, verifying that Scouts keep arrows in the quiver until the 1-blast signal.

bespoke_clusters.rule_of_thumb_mnemonic: Static arrow spine measures shaft deflection in thousandths of an inch when an 880-gram (1.94-lb) weight hangs on a 28-inch span.
core_mechanism_bullets: Static arrow spine measures shaft deflection in thousandths of an inch when an 880-gram (1.94-lb) weight hangs on a 28-inch span.
Before shooting, flex every carbon shaft 1 to 2 inches and twist while listening for splintering cracks or loose nocks.
